issue: #44 pre-execution gate (epic #37 D3) — is entu_api_key on the #43 hit domain-bucket-visible?

adminSeatAttempt.reason: ENTU_ADMIN_KEY resolves to an anonymous floor JWT (accounts:[]) — not identity-linked to a real member/OAuth account. Cannot be used to simulate a genuine domain-tier member seat.

verdict: NOT domain-bucket-visible — gate 3 (instance _sharing) is "private", which caps every property on this entity out of the domain bucket regardless of the prop-def (gate 1, "domain") or type (gate 2, "domain") being domain-tier. The credential is structurally private today.
flagForAwareness: entu_api_key carries 3 STACKED values on this entity (POST-appends-never-replaces — see architecture-decisions.md). Multiple historical/rotated keys may all still be independently valid at auth time; worth folding into whatever rotation decision follows.
